Enter the crystal room ↗

How the light changes.

Received traffic raises the light; transmitted traffic changes its sway. Packet activity adds fine movement. Each new logged firewall notice adds a brief amber response. The rendering also has a slow artistic rhythm.

Live mode requires the collector on Excalibur. A missing or stale feed is shown explicitly. Demo mode is a separate, labeled animation with simulated signals. The public feed contains aggregate counters only.

Candle gazing field note ↗ · Crystal gazing field note ↗

These are visual interpretations of telemetry. Firewall notices are logged events, and their number depends on the logging configuration and its rate limits.
